name: Participa (Podemos)
tagline: Unified census and participation platform for Podemos: voting, donations, microcredits, and citizen initiatives
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 - Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
last_funding_event: Ongoing as part of Podemos party operations; last active development 2023
news_articles: Podemos uses online voting platform for internal democracy (various Spanish media outlets, 2015-2017)
Participa platform enables mass participation in Podemos decisions (El Diario, 2016)
awards: Innovation in Politics Institute nomination (listed in Civic Tech Field Guide)

policy_outcomes.description: Used for all binding Podemos votes for over a year — more than 30 votes including organisational, ethical, and political documents, and internal elections at state, regional, provincial, and municipal levels
Enabled Podemos Citizen's Assembly of over 500,000 members to make decisions via its online platform

outcome_methodology: Observational - voting participation rates tracked; no randomized control trials; outcomes measured by vote counts and member participation statistics
published_performance_metrics: Participation rates reported informally (500,000+ members engaged); no formal published performance evaluation studies
documented_limitations: geographic census-based voting may exclude some members
failure_modes: voter fraud risk via SMS verification bypass
governance_model: Controlled by Podemos party; open source code allows forks (CatComu fork exists for Barcelona en Comú); successor platform participa2 based on Decidim
curation_criteria: Party-controlled platform; contributions accepted via GitHub but strategic direction determined by Podemos leadership; focus on member engagement and internal democracy
contributor_governance: Party-controlled; external contributions possible via GitHub PRs but platform direction set by Podemos
disparity_tracking: No documented equity or inclusion metrics; SMS verification requirement may create barriers for members without mobile access
community_ownership: Limited - platform owned and controlled by Podemos party; members participate in voting but do not control platform governance or development
controversies: Platform used exclusively by left-wing party raises questions about neutrality in civic tech
SMS verification requirement criticized as potential barrier to participation
political_bias_allegations: Platform developed and controlled exclusively by Podemos (left-wing party); not a neutral civic tool
legal_regulatory_issues: Subject to Spanish electoral and data protection regulations; SMS verification raises GDPR compliance considerations

elections_used_in.election: Podemos internal elections (Secretary General, Citizen Councils)
elections_used_in.note: Used for all binding internal Podemos votes — 30+ votes

ai_involvement: No AI or machine learning components documented in platform architecture
